promise: Bring a proven capability to the host you use.
audience: Developers bringing an observed donor capability into one or more existing hosts.
trigger: Use for a bounded capability transfer across architectures or languages, while keeping host boundaries intact.

modes.name: Gap check
modes.when: A donor seems useful but host overlap is unclear.
modes.output: Observed donor contract and an explicit keep/drop rationale per host.

modes.name: Re-express
modes.when: A missing capability and host seam are known.
modes.output: A native host slice with tests, real-surface probe, and CI parity.

modes.name: Verify
modes.when: The builder reports a transfer complete.
modes.output: A donor-derived check, bounded reopen, and retained evidence or blocker.

examples.title: A client feature with a server prerequisite
examples.brief: A fictional donor lets users pause a job; two target clients lack it and their shared runtime has no pause operation.
examples.before: Copy donor code into both clients and mark two features complete.
examples.after: Describe pause/resume behavior, add the runtime protocol first, then implement each client in its own seam and test actual state transitions.
examples.why: The capability crosses hosts through an explicit contract; client UI cannot manufacture backend behavior.

boundaries: The donor is read-only; transfer observable behavior by re-expression, not source grafting.
Existing host conventions and authority boundaries win over donor implementation choices.
Optional HGT graphs, ledgers, Forge, and Amplifier are execution aids; declared fitness is not benefit evidence.

verification.name: Ledger ratchet detector
verification.evidence: Builder/verifier state regressions rejected and synthetic fixture curve read. No new donor-host transfer or user benefit claimed.
verification.expected: The stated scope passes; no broader result inferred.

verification.name: Executable graph syntax
verification.evidence: Both retained graphs parse. No graph/orchestration changes or paid pipeline execution.
verification.expected: The stated scope passes; no broader result inferred.

verification.name: Portable packaging and install
verification.command: python3 scripts/capability.py build; python3 scripts/capability.py check; python3 scripts/capability.py doctor; python3 scripts/capability.py install --dest <temporary-parent> (twice)
verification.expected: Byte-identical canonical ZIP and isolated idempotent install.
verification.evidence: All operations passed. No runtime activation or effectiveness measured.

verification.name: Skill discovery metadata
verification.expected: Valid required frontmatter, naming, and complete scaffold.
verification.evidence: Skill is valid. This is a structural check, not a behavioral benchmark.

sources.role: Primary history and engine retained; methods consolidated behind the canonical portable entry.

evidence_summary: This local candidate preserves the original source and evaluation assets. Packaging and native software checks are recorded separately from comparative usefulness. No outside-user outcome or renamed-method effectiveness claim is established.
publication_status: Installation and evidence scopes are documented below.
